Package com.j3d.engine.scene

Class SceneManager

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.engine.scene.SceneManager
public class SceneManager extends Object
SceneManager is the class. The main class that handles the rendering of 3D objects onto a 2D screen.

      public void axis(Graphics2D g, Camera camera)
      Draws the 3D Cartesian axes (X, Y, Z) in the scene, relative to the camera's position. The length of the axes is scaled based on the camera's distance from the origin.
      Parameters:
      g - The Graphics2D object to draw on.
      camera - The camera instance used for perspective transformation.

    • select

      public SelectionManager select(SelectionQuery selectionQuery)
      Updates the current selection based on the provided SelectionQuery.

      This method modifies the current selection according to the type specified in the selectionQuery:

      • SelectionType.ALL: Selects all objects within the defined area.
      • SelectionType.BOUNDS_STRICT: Selects objects fully contained within the selection boundaries.
      • SelectionType.BOUNDS_SOFT: Selects objects that intersect with or are partially within the selection boundaries.
      • SelectionType.SUBTRACT: Inverts the current selection, selecting unselected objects and deselecting selected ones.
      • SelectionType.UNION: Adds objects from the new selection to the existing selection.
      • SelectionType.INCLUDE: Adds objects from the new selection to the existing selection.
      • SelectionType.EXCLUDE: Removes objects from the existing selection that are present in the new selection.

      Parameters:
      selectionQuery - The SelectionQuery defining the selection criteria and type.

    • resetScene

      public void resetScene()
      Resets the entire scene by clearing all layers, selections, and unregistering all triangles from the SceneRenderer. This effectively returns the sceneManager to an empty state, ready for a new project or scene.
